q: Does diesel burned testing our fire pump count in Scope 1?
title: Fire pump diesel testing
short: Yes. Diesel fire pumps are run for weekly or monthly tests, and the fuel they burn is Scope 1 at 2.68 kg CO2 per litre. The amounts are small, but verifiers often ask for it. Record top-ups in a log and keep the fuel invoices or issue slips.

ul: Diesel for fire tenders or emergency vehicles.
CO2 fire extinguishers refilled after use.

p: If the total is below your exclusion threshold, you may list it as excluded with the reason, but measuring it costs little.

senseible: Senseible reads fuel invoices and electricity bills and applies IPCC 2006 factors and the CEA grid factor (0.710 kg CO2 per kWh for FY 2024-25), so you can compare Scope 1 and 2 before and after a change from the documents themselves.
